20261119-chemistry-g09.topic: Mgbe 4 g nke ọla kọpa meghachiri nke ọma
20261119-chemistry-g09.goal: Tinye ụkpụrụ nke Mgbe 4 g nke ọla kọpa meghachiri nke ọma iji dozie nsogbu nnyocha.
20261119-chemistry-g09.material: Etinyere ntụ ọla kọpa n'ime crucible ma kpoo ya n'ikuku iji mepụta copper(II) oxide. Mgbe 4 g nke ọla kọpa meghachiri nke ọma, a mepụtara 5 g nke copper(II) oxide. Kedu oke oxygen jikọtara na oke ọla kọpa na oxygen?
20261119-chemistry-g09.thinking.0: Mgbe 4 g nke ọla kọpa meghachiri nke ọma

20261119-chemistry-g09.s.s1.explain: Oke oxygen meghachiri bụ $5\text{ g} - 4\text{ g} = 1\text{ g}$. Dịka iwu nke ọnụọgụ edoro si dị, oke ọla kọpa na oxygen n'ime copper(II) oxide bụ mgbe niile $4 : 1$.

20261119-chemistry-g09.s.s1.hint.1: Iwu nke ọnụọgụ edoro: dị mfe oke ọla kọpa na oxygen.

20261121-chemistry-g09-1.material: Mgbe okpomọkụ na nrụgide bụ otu, hydrogen gas na oxygen gas na-emeghachi omume ka ha mepụta uzuoku mmiri. Kedu 'ọnụọgụ olu' ziri ezi nke hydrogen, oxygen na uzuoku mmiri a mepụtara? (Iwu nke mmeghachi omume gas)

20261121-chemistry-g09-2.s.s1.explain: Mmeghachi omume oxidation nke ígwè bụ mmeghachi omume exothermic na-ahapụ ume okpomọkụ gaa gburugburu ma welie okpomọkụ, ebe mgbaze nke ammonium nitrate bụ mmeghachi omume endothermic na-ewere ume okpomọkụ gburugburu ma wedata okpomọkụ.

20261122-chemistry-g09-1.material: [Coefficient mmeghachi omume dị elu] Mgbe propane gas (C₃H₈) na-agbaze kpamkpam na oxygen (O₂), a na-emepụta carbon dioxide (CO₂) na mmiri (H₂O). N'ime ahịrịokwu kemịkalụ a hazigharịrị C₃H₈ + a O₂ → b CO₂ + c H₂O, kedu ngụkọta coefficient (a + b + c)?
20261122-chemistry-g09-1.s.s1.prompt: [Coefficient mmeghachi omume dị elu] Mgbe propane gas (C₃H₈) na-agbaze kpamkpam na oxygen (O₂), a na-emepụta carbon dioxide (CO₂) na mmiri (H₂O). N'ime ahịrịokwu kemịkalụ a hazigharịrị C₃H₈ + a O₂ → b CO₂ + c H₂O, kedu ngụkọta coefficient (a + b + c)?

20261122-chemistry-g09-2.material: Hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂) na-agbaze n'ime mmiri na oxygen nke ukwuu n'okpomọkụ ụlọ. Mgbe etinyere obere ntụ black manganese dioxide (MnO₂), ụfụfụ (oxygen gas) pụtara dị ka mgbawa. Kedu ọrụ manganese dioxide?

20261121-chemistry-g10-1.s.s1.prompt: Kedu nkọwa ziri ezi nke 'oxidation' na 'reduction' dabere n'ịkwaga eletrọn n'ime kemistrị ọgbara ọhụrụ?
20261121-chemistry-g10-1.s.s1.explain: Site n'echiche nke ịkwaga eletrọn, mgbe ihe fụrụ eletrọn, a na-asị na ọ rụrụ oxidation, mgbe ọ nwetara eletrọn, a na-asị na ọ rụrụ reduction. Ebe ihe ọzọ na-enweta ọnụọgụ eletrọn dị ka nke e fụrụ, oxidation na reduction na-eme n'otu oge mgbe niile.
20261121-chemistry-g10-1.s.s1.hint.0: OIL RIG: Oxidation Is Loss (nke eletrọn), Reduction Is Gain (nke eletrọn)
20261121-chemistry-g10-1.s.s1.hint.1: Ịfụ eletrọn bụ oxidation, inweta eletrọn bụ reduction.
20261121-chemistry-g10-1.s.s1.o.o0: Oxidation bụ mmeghachi omume nke ịfụ eletrọn, ma reduction bụ mmeghachi omume nke inweta eletrọn
20261121-chemistry-g10-1.s.s1.o.o1: Oxidation bụ mmeghachi omume nke inweta eletrọn, ma reduction bụ mmeghachi omume nke ịfụ eletrọn
20261121-chemistry-g10-1.s.s1.o.o2: Oxidation na reduction na-eme n'onwe ha ma ha enweghị ike ime n'otu oge
20261121-chemistry-g10-1.s.s1.o.o3: A na-akọwa oxidation naanị mgbe ọ jikọtara na oxygen

20261121-chemistry-g10-2.material: Kedu ụkpụrụ nke 'cathodic protection (sacrificial anode method)' nke a na-etinye iberibe zinc (Zn) ma ọ bụ magnesium (Mg) iji gbochie àkwà mmiri ma ọ bụ ụgbọ mmiri e ji ígwè (Fe) rụọ ịgba ájá?
20261121-chemistry-g10-2.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ụkpụrụ nke 'cathodic protection (sacrificial anode method)' nke a na-etinye iberibe zinc (Zn) ma ọ bụ magnesium (Mg) iji gbochie àkwà mmiri ma ọ bụ ụgbọ mmiri e ji ígwè (Fe) rụọ ịgba ájá?
20261121-chemistry-g10-2.s.s1.explain: Mgbe a jikọtara zinc ma ọ bụ magnesium, nke na-eme oxidation dị mfe karịa ígwè (nwere mmasị ionization ka ukwuu), zinc na-efu eletrọn n'ọnọdụ ígwè ma na-eboro (oxidize), na-enye ígwè eletrọn mgbe niile, ya mere a na-egbochi corrosion nke ígwè site n'isi.
20261121-chemistry-g10-2.s.s1.hint.0: Mmasị ionization nke ọla: Mg > Zn > Fe > Cu
20261121-chemistry-g10-2.s.s1.hint.1: Ọla na-emeghachi omume karịa na-efu eletrọn mbụ ma chụọ onwe ya àjà.
20261121-chemistry-g10-2.s.s1.o.o0: N'ihi na zinc, nke na-emeghachi omume karịa ígwè (nwere mmasị ionization ka ukwuu), na-arụ oxidation tupu ígwè ma na-enye ígwè eletrọn
20261121-chemistry-g10-2.s.s1.o.o1: N'ihi na zinc na-ekpuchi ígwè ma gbochie ikuku kpamkpam
20261121-chemistry-g10-2.s.s1.o.o2: N'ihi na ígwè na-efu eletrọn dị mfe karịa zinc
20261121-chemistry-g10-2.s.s1.o.o3: N'ihi na zinc na-agbanwe mmiri oké osimiri ka ọ bụrụ mmiri ọcha

20261122-chemistry-g10-2.s.s1.prompt: Kedu nsogbu gburugburu ebe obibi nke sulfur dioxide (SO₂) ma ọ bụ nitrogen oxides (NOx) a tụfuru n'oge ire ụrị mmanụ ala na-emeghachi omume na uzuoku mmiri dị n'ikuku ka ọ bụrụ sulfuric acid ma ọ bụ nitric acid, wee mee ka pH mmiri ozuzo dị n'okpuru nke nkịtị (ihe dị ka 5.6)?
20261122-chemistry-g10-2.s.s1.explain: Sulfur oxides na nitrogen oxides na-emeghachi omume na mmiri dị n'ikuku ma mepụta sulfuric acid ($\text{H}_2\text{SO}_4$) na nitric acid ($\text{HNO}_3$), nke bụ acid dị ike, ya mere mmiri ozuzo acid siri ike nwere $\text{pH} < 5.6$ na-ezo, na-eme ka ala na ọdọ bụrụ acidic.
20261122-chemistry-g10-2.s.s1.hint.0: Oxide nke nonmetals dị n'ikuku na-aghọ acidic mgbe ọ gbazere n'ime mmiri.
20261122-chemistry-g10-2.s.s1.hint.1: Ọ na-ezo aka n'ozuzo nwere pH dị n'okpuru 5.6.
